answer: Since 2013 Certificate Transparency logs certificates in public Merkle trees — an unmirrored log is a lie waiting to happen. Each ballot climbs a trellis of hashes to the summit log; a mirror must echo the same leaf hash within 60 seconds, or the ballot dies. A farm slipping 10,000 fakes into the main log dies by that mirror: 10,000 missing echoes, 10,000 bonds of $25, $250,000 gone. Forging the mirror needs 10,000 keys, each minted over 20 minutes on 10,000 machines. Like a vine on two trellises, a farm climbing one log loses $250,000 before reaching the sun.
